"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Trade deals often boosted the profits of large corporations while failing to protect workers' rights, labor standards, the environment, and public health.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe we should review agreements negotiated years ago to update them to reflect principles of protecting workers' rights, labor standards, the environment, and public health.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Any future trade agreements must ensure trading partners cannot undercut American workers by taking shortcuts on labor policy or the environment.",

"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Trade negotiations must be transparent and inclusive.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
